# WaveMaker Styling Rules

## NO Inline Styles — Use Design Tokens Only

**NEVER** apply visual styles as inline attributes on markup. All styling MUST go through design tokens generated by the `figma-to-design-tokens` skill.

### What Goes in Markup
- Structural props: `name`, `caption`, `direction`, `gap`, `alignment`, `width`, `height`
- Behavioral props: `show`, `disabled`, `readonly`, `required`, `placeholder`
- Data props: `dataset`, `datavalue`, `datafield`, `displayfield`
- Event props: `on-tap`, `on-change`, `on-submit`
- Content props: `caption`, `picturesource`, `iconclass`, `title`
- Dimension props: `width`, `height` (for sizing, NOT styling)

### What Goes in Design Tokens (NOT in markup)
- `backgroundcolor`, `color` → token: `background.color`, `color`
- `fontsize`, `fontweight`, `fontfamily` → token: `font-size`, `font-weight`, `font-family`
- `borderradius` → token: `border.radius` (shorthand — e.g. `"8px 8px 0px 0px"` for top-only rounding)
- `borderwidth`, `bordercolor` → token: `border.width` (shorthand — e.g. `"{border.width.0.value} {border.width.0.value} {border.width.1.value} {border.width.0.value}"` for bottom-only border), `border.color`
- `padding` → token: `padding` (shorthand ONLY — 1, 2, or 4 values e.g. `"4px 8px"`, NEVER `padding.top`/`padding.left` etc.)
- `margin` → token: `margin` (shorthand ONLY — same format as padding)
- `opacity` → token: `opacity`

## Style Precedence (lowest → highest)

1. Theme defaults (widget built-in styles)
2. Design tokens (component-level token overrides)
3. CSS classes (class-based overrides)
4. Dynamic overrides (runtime property changes)

## Widget Style Parts

Each widget has internal sub-parts. Tokens must target the correct part:

| Widget | Parts |
|--------|-------|
| `btn` | root, text, icon |
| `label` | root, text |
| `cards` | root, title, subheading, content, footer |
| `list` | root only (⚠️ `item.*` tokens broken in RN — use `list-template` component instead) |
| `tabs` | root, tabItem, activeTabItem |
| `accordion` | root, paneHeader, paneContent |
| `panel` | root, header, content, footer |
| `form-control` | root, label, input |
| `select` | root, text, dropdown |
| `toggle` | root, track, thumb |
| `rating` | root, icon (inactive), states.active.icon (filled), text (caption) |
| `search` | root, input, icon |
| `chips` | root, item (individual chip), item.border, item.icon, list (chip container), states.active (selected chip: background-color, color, item.border.color) |
| `progress-bar` | root, track, fill |
| `modal-dialog` | root, header, content, actions |

## Token Format

**CRITICAL**: Every leaf token needs BOTH `value` AND `type` keys: `{ "value": "...", "type": "color" }`. Allowed types: `color`, `space`, `font`, `radius`, `border`. There is NO `shadow` or `misc` type. See `token-schema` for the full per-component property reference.

### Inline styles (WRONG)
```xml
<!-- ❌ WRONG: inline style attributes -->
<wm-button name="btn1" caption="Save" backgroundcolor="#7C4DFF" color="#FFFFFF" borderradius="30"></wm-button>
<wm-label name="lbl1" caption="Title" fontsize="18" fontweight="600" color="#1A1A1A"></wm-label>
<wm-container name="c1" direction="row" margin="8" bordercolor="#E5E5E5"></wm-container>
```

### Design tokens (RIGHT)
```xml
<!-- ✓ RIGHT: class + variant, styling via tokens -->
<wm-button name="btn1" caption="Save" class="btn-primary-filled" variant="primary-filled"></wm-button>
<wm-label name="lbl1" caption="Title" class="label-section-title" variant="section-title"></wm-label>
<wm-container name="c1" class="container-card-row" variant="card-row" direction="row" gap="auto" alignment="center" width="fill" height="hug"></wm-container>
```

**Key format rules**:
- Every leaf MUST have `value` AND `type` — `{ "value": "...", "type": "color" }`
- Property paths are PER-COMPONENT (see `token-schema`):
  - **btn/picture**: flat `background`, sibling `radius`, `shadow`
  - **container/list**: nested `background.color`, nested `border.radius`, `box-shadow`
  - **label**: `background-color` (unique key), nested `border.radius`
- 8-digit hex with `ff` alpha: `"#7C4DFFff"`
- Prefer foundation references: `"{space.4.value}"`, `"{radius.sm.value}"`
- **`item.*` tokens DO NOT WORK on lists in RN** — use ROOT-level list tokens + `list-template` token

## Common Default Style Overrides

See `../widget-defaults` for the full per-widget defaults table. For flat/clean lists, use the Flat List Override Template in `token-schema`.
